sentences.en: I experienced intense cold at the South Pole last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我在南极经历了强烈的寒冷。

sentences.en: Their feelings are intense and they tend to be jealous.
sentences.zh: 他们的感情很强烈，容易嫉妒。

sentences.en: Fadil and Layla's attraction to each other was enormously intense.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔和莱拉彼此之间的吸引力非常强烈。
